task.originalRequest: Compare two synthetic workflow policies from supplied text only.
task.goal: Explain the tradeoff between central planning and lightweight coordination.
task.context: Policy A: one expert plans and integrates independent workers. Policy B: an expert designs stable batches; a lighter coordinator manages them and asks an expert advisor about exceptions.
acceptance: Address both policies and distinguish architectural benefits from unmeasured cost/quality claims.
constraints: Read-only reasoning exercise. No tools, web retrieval, files, recursive delegation or performance claims.

units.prompt: Identify when policy A is appropriate and one limitation from the supplied context.
Identify when policy B is appropriate and one limitation from the supplied context.
